title: Output schema of Arabam.com Vehicle Scraper
description: This actor stores scraped vehicle listings in the default dataset. As of 1.1.0, the RUN_SUMMARY is stored in the run's key-value store (key "RUN_SUMMARY"), not the dataset — see the runSummary entry below.

vehicleListings.title: Vehicle listings
vehicleListings.description: Structured vehicle listing records from Arabam.com. In Apify Console this opens the overview dataset view by default.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: RUN_SUMMARY key-value store record with totals, duration, warnings, and the effective input summary for the scrape. BREAKING CHANGE (1.1.0): previously a dataset row (view=runSummary); now a key-value store record.
